environment.description: Migration script runs on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with internet gateway attached. The migration_templates table is populated from a tenant onboarding API where tenant administrators can customize their schema naming via a web form. The template_source column stores raw Jinja2 template strings that include user-supplied tenant_name values without sanitization. The instance has IAM role with SecretsManager and S3 read access.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, internet gateway, default route 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw
config.instance: EC2 t3.medium, public IP assigned, security group allows all outbound
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL in same VPC, migration_templates table writable by tenant API
config.template_source: User-controlled via tenant onboarding API, stored in migration_templates table
